item.title: Report: Veteran Jets D-Man Luke Schenn Open To A Trade
item.description: Being a 'seller' as we get into trade season is not the position the Winnipeg Jets expected to find themselves in this year. But here we are. With that, some of their veterans are becoming trade candidates. None make more sense than Luke Schenn.
